effect.shortEffect: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
effect.full: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

french.sv: Quand le Pokémon est touché par une capacité\nphysique, il répand des pics toxiques dans le camp\nadverse.
